description: Fit early aggregate C-peptide ratios and evaluate later visits without using them in optimization. Read beta_cell_guide first. Returns simple-baseline errors, identifiability checks, source snapshots, solver replay manifests and eight hypothetical mechanism combinations. Stateless and read-only. No ranking, clinical prediction or automatic Agent Council ratification.

customDataset.description: Aggregate dataset, only when dataset=custom: {id, citation (https), population, assay, reportedUnit, kind, statistic, arms:[control, comparator] with 5 to 20 {week, value} points each}. See beta_cell_guide.

dataset.description: clver (bundled CLVer aggregate C-peptide data, default) or custom (supply customDataset).

durationWeeks.description: Scenario length in weeks: 52, 78 or 104. Default 52.

graftAttrition.description: Non-immune graft loss per week, 0 to 0.1. Default 0.01.

graftProtection.description: Fraction of graft protected from immune attack, 0 to 1. Default 0.8.

immuneSuppression.description: Fraction of autoimmune attack removed in the scenario, 0 to 1 (dimensionless). Default 0.5.

recoveryRate.description: Native beta-cell recovery rate per week, 0.02 to 0.3. Default 0.1.

replacementContribution.description: Added beta-cell function from replacement, relative to baseline, 0 to 2. Default 0.25.

trainingThroughWeek.description: Last week used for fitting (weeks). Fixed at 39 for clver; later visits are held out. Example 39.

name: run_beta_cell

_meta.description: source, generatedAt, sources (per-source lastSyncedAt and ageHours), rateLimit, disclaimer.

data.description: The answer. Shape depends on the tool; describe_tool documents it.
